ui.title: Prescription Safety Checker
ui.tagline: Checks every new e-prescription before a pharmacist verifies it: allergies, interactions, duplicate therapy and dose limits against the patient's chart and your formulary.

actions.label: Run: Prescription safety check
actions.description: A new e-prescription arrives. Kaman pulls the patient's allergies, current medicines, weight and kidney function and the formulary's dosing rules in parallel, checks for allergy matches, interactions, duplicate therapy and dose limits, and routes it: clear prescriptions go to the pharmacist's verification queue, issues go to a pharmacist with a timeout escalation, and severe ones are held with the prescriber told. Kaman never changes a prescription.

actions.label: Ask the Patient Chart Reader
actions.description: Pulls the parts of a patient's chart a prescription check needs from the connected FHIR server.
